mnemonic has been invited to join Europol’s CIEP initiative. The pilot, launched by Europol’s European Cybercrime Centre (EC3), brings together specialists from trusted private-sector organisations and Europol to effectively work together in the fight against cybercrime.
Read the full article
In 2025, mnemonic celebrates its 25th anniversary. We sat down with CEO Tønnes Ingebrigtsen to reflect on the company’s journey, the evolution of cybersecurity, and what has helped mnemonic grow and adapt in an ever-changing industry.
